name: llm_summarise
description: Summarises a piece of text in a few sentences, keeping names, figures and units exactly. Calls no tools. An example LLM tool (mode complete), disabled until an administrator enables it.

llm.system_prompt: You write short, faithful summaries. Keep names, numbers and units exactly as written.
llm.template:
Summarise the following text in at most {{input.max_sentences}} sentences.

{{input.text}}
